answer: Anchor each agent identity to a time-locked bond plus a public work ledger. New identities start with zero reputation and earn it only through completed tasks that independent counterparties attest. These attestations weave into a trellis: trust flows only along edges backed by real completed work, and every edge decays unless renewed by fresh verified activity. An orchard of fake identities is cheap to plant but costly to tend: each fake must keep doing real attested work or its reputation withers, so running a Sybil army costs more the bigger it gets while its influence stays near zero.
